title: Disclaimer

sections.body: Everything on theworldofai.org is published for general informational purposes. It is not legal, regulatory, compliance, financial, investment, tax, or professional advice, and it is not a substitute for advice from a licensed professional who knows your facts. No attorney-client, advisory, or fiduciary relationship is created by reading this Website, subscribing to our newsletter, or using our API.

Bill status, case posture, and regulatory requirements change daily and differ by jurisdiction. A bill that is pending when a page is generated may be enacted, amended, vetoed, or dead by the time you read it. Court dockets are updated on the courts' schedule, not ours. Always confirm status against the primary source linked on each page before relying on it.

Pages are generated automatically from public data sources including LegiScan, CourtListener and the federal dockets it mirrors, the Federal Register, and arXiv, combined with editorial reference material we maintain. Each page displays the date it was last verified. We do not invent facts: where data is missing, a page says less rather than filling the gap. If you find an error, tell us and we will correct it at the source.

Our coverage is broad but not exhaustive. The absence of a bill, case, tool, or term from this Website does not mean it does not exist. Counts and summaries reflect what our sources reported at the time of generation.

We describe and link to third-party products, services, filings, and publications. We do not control them, and inclusion is not endorsement. Pricing, features, and terms of third-party tools change without notice; confirm details with the vendor.

This Website earns revenue from advertising and, on some pages, affiliate commissions. Advertisements are selected by third-party ad networks, not by us, and their appearance is not an endorsement. Affiliate links are labeled and disclosed. No commercial relationship changes a verdict, a ranking, or a reported legal status. See our Disclosure.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, SRJ Consulting & Services LLC disclaims all liability for any loss or damage arising from reliance on this Website. Your use of the Website is at your own risk and subject to our Terms of Use.
